objective: Make a deleted node evict FAST from REMOTE meshes too (option B). Sprint-15's gossip tombstone only reaches the dead node's OWN mesh; cross-mesh, observers wait 30s for the staleness pruner. Add a backbone-level tombstone so the cross-mesh control plane propagates the departure fast.
context: AUDIT FINDING: sprint-15's claim that cross-mesh kills evict in ~6s 'via QUIC connection-close detection' was FABRICATED — there is NO connection-close eviction code (no NeighborDown/disconnect handler). Cross-mesh today = 30s pruner. This sprint fixes that for real.
mechanism: BackboneMessage enum wrapper (Summary | Tombstone) on blake3('rafka.backbone'). kill_one calls broadcast_backbone_tombstone → BACKBONE_TOMBSTONE_TX → run_backbone drains and broadcasts BackboneMessage::Tombstone. Every backbone subscriber (gateway + admin-ui) receives, calls apply_tombstone (source='backbone_receive'), drops dead node from live_digests + prunes backbone_summaries directory. Gateway's next MeshSummary publish omits dead node. Remote console's /api/topology-cache clears within one backbone interval (~2s). STALENESS_MS=120s proves pruner cannot be cause. No new transport; reuses existing backbone gossip topic.
acceptance_tests: T2 CROSS-MESH FAST EVICT (curl, MEASURED): two cross-seeded consoles (mesh1 :19100, mesh2 :19101). Kill a mesh2 node. On the mesh1 console's /api/topology-cache (which sees mesh2 via the backbone), the node is GONE within < 5s (record the measured time). It MUST be well under RAFKA_STALENESS_MS (30s).

T3 VIA BACKBONE, NOT PRUNER (span/log): a backbone-tombstone span/log proves the eviction propagated over the backbone control plane — NOT that the 30s staleness pruner did it. (Temporarily raise RAFKA_STALENESS_MS to 120s during the test so the pruner CANNOT be what evicted it — if the node still vanishes in <5s, the backbone tombstone did it.)
T4 SAME-MESH UNAFFECTED: sprint-15 same-mesh tombstone still evicts fast (regression check).
T5 CRASH FALLBACK INTACT: an ungraceful crash with no tombstone still evicts via the staleness pruner.
T6 NO HAND-EDIT (code): no process hand-edits another process's maps; eviction propagates through the backbone gossip receive path uniformly.
proof_required: The MEASURED <5s cross-mesh eviction with RAFKA_STALENESS_MS=120s (proving it wasn't the pruner); the backbone-tombstone span; before/after /api/topology-cache on BOTH consoles. Into docs/plans/mesh-v2/verify/screenshots/sprint18-crossmesh-evict/.
out_of_scope: lowering the global staleness threshold as the fix (must be a real propagated tombstone)

ports.note: fresh; cross-seed the two consoles so each sees the other via backbone; RAFKA_MDNS_ENABLE=false
